title: Osaka Castle falls and the Toyotomi line ends
summary: Tokugawa forces stormed Osaka Castle at the end of the summer campaign, and Toyotomi Hideyori and his mother took their own lives as it burned.
reason: Hideyori remained a rallying point for opponents of the Tokugawa, and Ieyasu wanted to remove the last rival claim to power.
significance: It removed the final challenge to the Tokugawa shogunate.
